user.title: Forecast place

missing_forecast_point.title: The stored forecast place for {entry_title} is no longer available
missing_forecast_point.description: The saved forecast place ID `{post_code}` can no longer be found in the latest MeteoSwiss forecast metadata. Remove the entry and add it again to choose a new forecast place.

missing_weather_station.title: The stored weather station for {entry_title} is no longer available
missing_weather_station.description: The saved weather station code `{station_code}` can no longer be found in the latest MeteoSwiss station metadata. Reconfigure the entry to pick a new weather station, or remove it.

missing_pollen_station.title: The stored pollen station for {entry_title} is no longer available
missing_pollen_station.description: The saved pollen station code `{station_code}` can no longer be found in the latest MeteoSwiss pollen metadata. Reconfigure the entry to pick a new pollen station, or turn pollen off for this entry.
